rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Kaname＊＠１２０＿００５Right?! I just knew you'd￥say that, Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２０＿００６Right?! I just knew you'd￥say that, Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２０＿００７Don't worry! I really thought￥it through before I decided...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Kaname Depart　－

＊Kaname＊＠１２０＿００９When you think about it, that￥went by in a flash, huh?＝＠１２０＿０１０But we got so much out of￥our time here.＝＠１２０＿０１１I'm sure all kinds of things are￥waiting for us from here on...＝＠１２０＿０１２But I'm not scared of￥anything... not with you!
